title: Derived-category connecting morphism is composition with the extension class
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a derived category and Ext as in [def-pc-ext], let $S:0\to X_1\to X_2\to X_3\to0$ be short exact, let $Y$ be an object, and let $x\in\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal C}(Y,X_3)$ with $n+1=m$. Under the derived-category identification of Ext with morphisms from $Y[0]$, the connecting morphism at degree $n$ in the long exact homology sequence of the distinguished triangle associated to $S$ sends the morphism representing $x$ to the morphism representing the Yoneda composite $[S]\circ x\in\operatorname{Ext}^{m}_{\mathcal C}(Y,X_1)$ (first $x$, then $[S]$; Mathlib's x.comp [S]), where $[S]\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_{\mathcal C}(X_3,X_1)$ is the extension class.
